title: Vodafone is sold on AI-RAN but not yet on need for GPUs
content: Vodafone is investigating the benefits of different network chips for AI-RAN at a Malaga facility, the company's head of RAN evolution tells an Omdia event.

title: SKT powers up AI data centers with Hyosung
content: SKT has partnered with Hyosung Heavy Industries to supply core equipment for the 345kV substations powering its AI data centers.
